title: Monthly invoice email
subtitle: A feature

sections.label: Feature plan
sections.claim: The month's invoice file arrives by email the day the books close.
sections.lead: Today the owner emails the file by hand each month.

sections.label: How it works
sections.claim: Setting up the monthly email takes four choices and one minute.
sections.lead: After that the file arrives by itself.

steps.title: Pick the tool
steps.text: Xero, QuickBooks or a plain spreadsheet.

steps.title: Pick the day
steps.text: The day the books close, not the first of the month.

steps.title: Add the bookkeeper
steps.text: An email address. The bookkeeper never needs to log in.

steps.title: Send a test
steps.text: A small file with last week's invoices arrives at once.

items.label: Day:
items.text: the closing day the owner picks, at 6 in the morning local time

items.label: Link:
items.text: works for 30 days, no login needed

items.label: Bounce:
items.text: shown on the export screen within five minutes

sections.label: Scope
sections.claim: It sends one file a month and does nothing else.

items.name: Monthly email with the file
items.line: One email a month on the closing day.

items.name: Bounce report
items.line: A bounce shows on the export screen.

items.name: Several addresses
items.line: One address for now; more when someone asks.

items: Sending to more than one address

sections.label: The file
sections.claim: Each accounting tool gets exactly the columns it expects.
sections.lead: The first rows of each tool's file.

sections.label: Decided
sections.claim: Two choices are already made, so nobody has to ask again.

sections.label: The build
sections.claim: Two steps, each proven before the next one starts.

sections.label: Proof
sections.claim: One check at the end proves the email arrives on the day.

sections.label: Kickoff
sections.claim: One prompt starts the build in a fresh session.

decided.what: The owner picks the day the email goes out
decided.why: Books close on different days, and a file that arrives early is incomplete.

decided.what: The bookkeeper never needs an account
decided.why: A link that works for 30 days is enough.

plan.summary: Three pieces of work in two steps, without pull request planning: one builder, one review, one final check.

waves.name: Schedule
waves.what: The owner picks the tool, day and address.

waves.name: Delivery
waves.what: The file goes out and bounces are reported.

tickets.title: The owner sets the tool, day and address once
tickets.goal: A settings card on the export screen saves the tool, the closing day and one email address for each customer.
done_when: The card saves and shows the next send date
A test email arrives within one minute

verify.run: Save the card on the local stack, then press Send a test
verify.expect: The next date shows and a test email lands within a minute

tickets.problem: The owner has nowhere to say which tool, which day and which address the file goes to.

tickets.title: The file goes out on the chosen day
tickets.goal: On the closing day a background job builds the month's file and emails a download link that works for 30 days.
done_when: The email arrives on the chosen day with a working link
A month with no invoices sends nothing

verify.run: Set the clock to the closing day and run the job
verify.expect: One email with a working link; an empty month sends nothing

tickets.problem: The file is built only when the owner clicks export, so it is late when they forget.

tickets.title: The owner hears when an email bounces
tickets.goal: A bounced email shows on the export screen with the reason, and the file stays there to download.
done_when: A bounce shows on the export screen within five minutes

verify.run: Send to an address the test mail server rejects
verify.expect: The bounce and its reason show on the export screen

tickets.problem: A wrong address fails silently and the bookkeeper never gets the file.

verification.summary: One check on the local stack with a seeded account, about 15 minutes.

checks.title: The month's file arrives on the day
checks.expect: With the clock set to the closing day, one email goes out with a working link; a bad address shows a bounce.
checks.pass: One email in the test inbox, the link downloads the file, and the bounce shows on the screen.

kickoff: Build Monthly invoice email from its book: <book URL>. Open this chat in the Fieldnote repo. Read the book with the Artifact tool and status, run and log with ArtifactData, and follow the living-artifact skill's run.md. One builder, one review per piece of work, then the final check. Decide what you can and record it in decided; ask me in chat only when a choice is mine and blocks the work.
